title: Model version anchor wires and grooming notes
body:
Purpose
---
This working doc collects UI wire writeups, copy experiments, and backlog items for the "version anchor" UX: a clearer way for customers to lock an endpoint to a specific model version or a controlled set of variants (canary, fallback) without using the word "pin" in our product language. Goal: reduce accidental drift, make rollouts explicit, and surface fallback/cost tradeoffs at creation time.

Context & motivation
---
Why an "anchor"? Several merchants and platform teams told us they interpret "pin" as permanent and hard to change. "Anchor" implies intentional binding plus a visible release process. We want a creation flow that:
- Makes the current model version explicit (hash + semantic version)
- Shows compatible fallbacks and expected latency/cost differences
- Lets teams stage a canary rollout and schedule automatic rollback thresholds
- Integrates with routing policies and Dedicated capacity settings

Key screens (wire writeups)
---
1) Catalog -> Quick-anchor modal (compact)
- Purpose: fast path for experienced users to create an endpoint anchored to a version.
- Elements: model card (name, version tag, short perf stats), anchor toggle, route name, region dropdown, quick cost hint (est. tokens/sec cost), create button.
- Microcopy examples:
  - Heading: "Create endpoint anchored to v2025-02-03-alpha"
  - Anchor toggle label: "Anchor to exact version (recommended for stable prod)"
  - Cost hint: "Estimated cost: ~0.8x baseline (quantized)"
  - Create button: "Create anchored endpoint"
- Edge: show warning if chosen model variant is experimental.

2) Anchor detail flow (full wizard)
- Step 1: Basic info (name, description, visibility)
- Step 2: Version selection (exact hash, latest stable, or suggested variants). Include a small diff of tokenizer/params when selecting a different variant.
- Step 3: Rollout & failover policy:
  - Canary % slider (0-20%) + duration (hrs)
  - Failure threshold: e.g., 5% error OR +200ms p50 latency delta
  - Automatic rollback toggle with confirmation microcopy: "If threshold exceeded, rollback to anchor fallback"
- Step 4: Cost/latency preview: list expected p50/p95 and token cost relative to a baseline.
- Confirmation screen shows a human-readable summary, plus optional link to create an eval suite and baseline prompts.

3) Endpoint settings (post-creation)
- Display anchor state: "Anchored to v2025-02-03-alpha" badge with small "change anchor" action.
- Version history timeline with notes from model onboarding (commit message, quantization used).
- Quick actions: add fallback variant, start canary, schedule maintenance window.

Microcopy experiments (short list to test)
---
- Anchor button: 
  - Option A: "Anchor to this version"
  - Option B: "Lock endpoint to exact version"
  - Option C: "Bind to version (canaryable)"
- Confirmation modal copy variants: 
  - Variant 1 (concise): "This will bind your endpoint to v2025-02-03-alpha. You can change the anchor later, or add a fallback. Proceed?"
  - Variant 2 (explicit): "Anchoring prevents automatic model roll-forward. Newer model releases won't change this endpoint unless you update the anchor. Add a canary to test prospective versions first."
- Toast messages: "Endpoint created — anchored to v2025-02-03-alpha. Start canary?" or "Anchor updated. Canary will start in 5 minutes."

Acceptance criteria (grooming-ready)
---
AC-1: User can create an endpoint anchored to an exact model version from the catalog in < 3 clicks.
AC-2: Anchor creation shows cost/latency preview and at least one compatible fallback variant.
AC-3: User can configure a canary (%) and automatic rollback threshold.
AC-4: Endpoint details surface the anchor value and version history.
AC-5: Changing anchor requires an explicit confirmation and a short textual explanation of consequences.

Backlog items (prioritized)
---
- PROD-ANCH-01: Quick-anchor modal implementation (priority P0) - 5 story points
- PROD-ANCH-02: Full anchor wizard (P1) - 8 story points
- PROD-ANCH-03: Cost/latency estimation plug-in for modal (P0) - 3 story points
- PROD-ANCH-04: Anchor badge + version timeline UI (P1) - 5 story points
- PROD-ANCH-05: Canary automation + rollback engine hook (P0, infra coordination) - 13 story points
- PROD-ANCH-06: Microcopy A/B experiments (P2) - 2 story points
- PROD-ANCH-07: Telemetry events for anchored endpoints (track anchor changes, canary outcomes) (P0) - 3 story points

Open questions / design tradeoffs
---
- Should anchors be editable by default or require a protected role? Proposal: allow editing but surface an audit confirmation; optionally gate in enterprise plan.
- How to present cost delta when multiple quantization options exist? Use worst-case and best-case ranges and highlight the default runtime profile.
- Naming: "anchor" vs "lock" vs "pin" — we should run a small research pulse with 6 users to validate language (A/B test on microcopy).
- Rollout UX: Do we auto-create an evaluation run during canary? Pros: faster detection. Cons: noisy. Default: opt-in with one-click from confirmation screen.

Accessibility notes
---
- Ensure the canary slider is keyboard-operable and labeled with exact percentages.
- Confirmation modals must present consequences in plain language and include a clear cancel path.
- Badges should have aria-labels with the version hash and human-friendly label.

Test scenarios (QA)
---
- Create quick anchor from catalog -> verify endpoint created, anchor badge present, and telemetry event emitted.
- Start a 10% canary for 2 hours, simulate latency regression -> verify automatic rollback triggers and notification displayed.
- Change anchor to a newer version -> confirm explicit modal and audit log entry.
- Attempt to create anchor with an incompatible runtime (CPU-only) -> show blocker and suggested variants.

Rollout plan (phases)
---
- Phase 0: Internal dogfood deploy to infra team + 2 pilot customers (2 weeks)
- Phase 1: Gradual enable for 20% of new endpoint creations with an "Try anchor" callout (4 weeks)
- Phase 2: Full GA and docs + SDK examples (2 weeks)

Design notes and quick sketches (ASCII)
---
Catalog card compact modal sketch: 
[ Model card ]  v2025-02-03-alpha  [Anchor toggle: ON]
Name: my-qa-endpoint
Region: us-west-2
Cost: ~0.85x
[ Create anchored endpoint ]

Wizard step 3 (rollout) sketch:
Canary: [====|-----] 10%   Duration: 2h
Failure threshold: [5% errors]  [Auto-rollback: ON]

Next steps (action items)
---
- MX: run 6-user microcopy test (Ethan) — due Mar 7
- Eng: estimate PROD-ANCH-05 infra work and sync with SRE (Marco) — due Mar 4
- Docs: draft quickstart and API examples for anchored endpoints (Priya) — due Mar 14

Notes to reviewers
---
This doc is intentionally a working artifact. Looking for feedback on: copy tone (anchor vs lock), the canary configuration defaults, and whether the cost preview needs a separate verification spike. Add comments inline or ping in #product-console.
